result.title: Recurrent Amplification and Exact Nonexpansiveness Criteria for Query-Driven Erasure
result.summary: The Query-derived Erase Direction (QED) augments a rank-one linear attention update with a key-orthogonal query component. Under scalar decay, this correction leaves the eigenvalues of each homogeneous state transition unchanged, while the propagation of an initial perturbation depends on the ordered product of these transitions. We construct a periodic token sequence with fixed key and query projections for which every one-step spectral radius is below one but the spectral radius of the period product exceeds one. The same construction yields a sufficient condition for mean-square growth under independent uniform token sampling. For rank-one erasure with channel-wise decay, we derive a necessary and sufficient spectral-norm test for one-step nonexpansiveness that can be evaluated in $O(d)$ time. The test agrees with direct singular value decomposition on all 1,800 operators evaluated. In a counterfactual replay of a selected head of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, the terminal gain on a 4,096-token repeated-text sequence increased from 0.99938 to 1.3977 with the feature and checkpoint gate trajectories held fixed.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究带 query 驱动擦除的秩一线性注意力状态转移：构造一段周期性 token 序列，使单步谱半径均小于 1 而周期乘积谱半径大于 1，从而说明扰动可递归放大；并给出通道级衰减下 O(d) 的单步非扩张谱范数判据，在 Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base 单个头上做反事实回放验证终端增益上升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其状态转移谱分析与擦除机制可供核查 latent 推理状态在多步更新中是否稳定、是否出现递归放大，以及这类动力学能否解释长序列/长度泛化下的信息保留与坍缩；但对象是线性注意力记忆更新而非多模态推理，迁移需自行判断。
